replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Some things to point out about this map:
- There is too much void space. For example, the amount of space in between all monuments and the rest of the map is too much. The best way to fix this is to expand the current islands present in the map or add more islands.
- Island size and shape aren't the best. The island in which you spawn on, is way too small and the shape of the actual island is really blocky.
- Similarity to other maps. This looks like it was based off of two of Avicus's current maps (Rendezvous and Quintus) Make sure you are keeping your maps unique!
- Lack of detail. There isn't all that much detail to the map (Floor pattern and structures)

Side Note: I can do the YAML for you, if you wish.
